itemtemplate.name: Close-Fitting %name%
itemtemplate.text: A skilful smith has made this armour more difficult to overcome with critical hits. While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 79

itemtemplate.name: Ancient Close Fitting %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Elven, Dwarven
You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor: While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Cunning-Make %name%
itemtemplate.text: A skilled craftsman has made this piece of equipment lighter or less cumbersome than its lesser counterparts. The item is half the normal weight, and if it normally imposes disadvantage on fatigue saving throws, this version doesn't.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 79

itemtemplate.name: Ancient Cunning Make %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Elven, Dwarven
You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. This armor is half the normal weight, and if it normally imposes disadvantage on fatigue saving throws, this version doesn't.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Fell %name%
itemtemplate.text: Hard and straight, a critical hit from this weapon is more dangerous. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, you can roll two additional weapon damage dice and add them to the extra damage.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 79

itemtemplate.name: Superior Fell %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Elven, Númenórean Special: Bane (if Númenórean)
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with this weapon. This increases to three additional dice if it is of Elven craftsmanship, or to four additional dice against bane creatures (if Númenórean).
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Grievous %name%
itemtemplate.text: The weapon is strong and heavy, inflicting more harm on its targets. You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls with this weapon.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 79

itemtemplate.name: Superior Grievous %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Dwarven, Númenórean Special: Bane (if Númenórean)
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus to damage rolls increases to +2 if it is of Dwarven craftsmanship, or to +3 against bane creatures (if Númenórean).
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Keen %name%
itemtemplate.text: Sharp or better-balanced, this weapon is now more likely to produce a critical hit when hitting its target. Attacks using this weapon score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 79

itemtemplate.name: Superior Keen %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Dwarven, Elven Special: Bane (if Elven)
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, attacks using this weapon score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20, or 18-20 against bane creatures (if Elven).
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Reinforced %name%
itemtemplate.text: The shield's structure is reinforced, possibly with a metal rim or a larger iron boss, letting its wearer parry blows with greater ease. While holding this shield, you have a +1 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 79

itemtemplate.name: Superior Reinforced %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Any Special: Bane (if Elven or Númenórean)
While holding this shield, you have a +1 bonus to AC. The bonus increases to +2 if the shield is of Dwarven or Elven craftsmanship, or to +3 against attacks from bane creatures (if Númenórean). This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Biting Dart %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Elven Special: Bane
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. If you hit a bane creature using this weapon, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Cleaving %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Any
You can make one melee attack with this magic weapon as a bonus action on each of your turns.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Flame of Hope %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Dwarven
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While you hold this weapon drawn, it creates an aura in a 10-foot radius around you. You and all creatures friendly to you in the aura have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 133

itemtemplate.name: Foe-Slaying %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Elven, Númenórean Special: Bane
When you hit a bane creature with this magic weapon, you can roll one additional weapon damage die, or two additional dice if it is of Elven craftsmanship.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Gleam of Terror %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Dwarven
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a bonus action, you can cause the weapon emit dim light in a radius equal to its reach until the start of your next turn. The light is sunlight. While the weapon gleams, it also deals radiant damage instead of its normal type.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Hammering %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: any
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, when you hit a creature with it, the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or fall prone.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Hollow Steel %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Númenórean Special: no Bane required
You can make one ranged attack with this magic weapon as a bonus action on each of your turns.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Luminescence %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Elven Special: Bane
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The weapon glows with a pale, cold light when a bane creature is within 500 feet of it, shedding dim light in a radius equal to its reach. While the weapon is glowing, you and any of your companions within 30 feet of you that can see you cannot be surprised by these creatures, and have advantage on initiative rolls.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Rune-Scored %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Dwarven
You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this armor.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Rune-Scored %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Dwarven
While holding this shield, you gain a +1 bonus to AC (in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC) and saving throws.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Rune-Scored %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Dwarven
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134

itemtemplate.name: Straight Flight %name%
itemtemplate.text:
Craftsmanship: Any
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you make a ranged attack roll with this magic weapon, your target gains no benefit from cover, other than total cover, and you suffer no disadvantage due to long range.
itemtemplate.source: The Lord of the Rings p. 134
